before: aModeled cohort: women aged 49 years starting neoadjuvant chemotherapy for stage II or III triple-negative breast cancer in Japan (Table 1). Chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab compared with chemotherapy alone. Cells show deterministic estimates; where probabilistic analysis was run, the 95% UI [2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of 1,000 probabilistic sensitivity analysis samples] follows in brackets. Probability cost-effective: share of samples with a positive net monetary benefit. Costs in JPY 1,000 at fiscal year 2026 prices, discounted at 2% per year over a lifetime horizon; categories may not add to the total because of rounding. Scenarios are defined in Table 1. A dash means not computed. HR, hazard ratio; ICER, incremental cost-effectiveness ratio; JPY, Japanese yen; pCR, pathological complete response; QALY, quality-adjusted life year; UI, uncertainty interval.
